scripts.build: cargo build --workspace --release && OUT_DIR="${LET_HOME:-${TOOLS_HOME:-$HOME/.tools}/let}" && mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR" && cp target/release/let "$OUT_DIR/let" && cp target/release/let-tui "$OUT_DIR/let-tui"
scripts.build:sources: cargo run -q -p let-cli -- build sources all --jobs 3
scripts.build:source:broadband: cargo run -q -p let-cli -- build sources broadband
scripts.build:source:postcodes: cargo run -q -p let-cli -- build sources postcodes
scripts.build:source:deprivation: cargo run -q -p let-cli -- build sources deprivation
scripts.build:source:census: cargo run -q -p let-cli -- build sources census
scripts.build:source:population: cargo run -q -p let-cli -- build sources population
scripts.build:source:income: cargo run -q -p let-cli -- build sources income
scripts.build:source:flood: cargo run -q -p let-cli -- build sources flood
scripts.build:source:naptan: cargo run -q -p let-cli -- build sources naptan
scripts.build:source:uprn: cargo run -q -p let-cli -- build sources uprn
scripts.build:source:crime: cargo run -q -p let-cli -- build sources crime
scripts.util:check: STATUS=0; bun run util:format || STATUS=1; bun run util:lint || STATUS=1; bun run util:types || STATUS=1; bun run util:test || STATUS=1; bun run build || STATUS=1; exit $STATUS
